Final review complete. The fix in src/dotenv/main.py (set_key, lines 184-187) is correct and minimal:

    if quote:
        value_out = "'{}'".format(
            value_to_set.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("'", "\\'")
        )

Backslashes are escaped before apostrophes, matching the parser's single-quote escape set (`\\`, `\'`). This makes `quote_mode='always'` and `quote_mode='auto'` round-trip literal backslashes, consecutive backslashes, and backslash-before-apostrophe sequences exactly through `dotenv_values(interpolate=False)`. The `quote_mode` selection logic, `export` handling, and all other behavior are unchanged; no tests or other files were touched.

Remaining limitations: `quote_mode='never'` still writes values unquoted, so values containing newlines or `#` are not round-trippable — this is pre-existing intended behavior and out of scope. No other limitations observed.
